# @moku-labs/ai — full LLM reference

> A build system for AI-generated assets — declarative build files in, artifacts out.
> Any task × any provider × any account pool. Resumable always, incremental by default,
> never loses a byte of progress. Built on @moku-labs/core (Layer 2 of the three-layer
> Moku model). Version 0.1.0. Bun exclusively; Node >= 24, Bun >= 1.3.14.

Contents:
1. Architecture & factory chain
2. Public package surface
3. Core plugins: journal, store, limits (full types + APIs)
4. Regular plugins: registry, buildfile, runner, voiceover, translate, promptGen,
   elevenlabs, openai, compose, cli (full types + APIs)
5. Complete event catalog
6. Config schema (every field, type, default)
7. Complete usage examples
8. Error handling patterns
9. Plugin dependency graph + initialization order
10. Extension patterns (custom plugins)

================================================================================
1. ARCHITECTURE & FACTORY CHAIN
================================================================================

Layer 1 — src/config.ts:

```ts
export type Config = {};   // empty by ratified decision — all configuration is per-plugin
export type Events = {};   // empty — the runner declares its own events (register-callback pattern)

export const coreConfig = createCoreConfig<Config, Events, [
  typeof logPlugin, typeof envPlugin, typeof journalPlugin,
  typeof storePlugin, typeof limitsPlugin
]>("ai", {
  config: {},
  plugins: [logPlugin, envPlugin, journalPlugin, storePlugin, limitsPlugin]
});

export const createPlugin = coreConfig.createPlugin; // framework-scoped plugin factory
export const createCore = coreConfig.createCore;     // framework assembler
```

Layer 2 — src/index.ts:

```ts
const framework = createCore(coreConfig, {
  plugins: [
    registryPlugin, buildfilePlugin, runnerPlugin, voiceoverPlugin, translatePlugin,
    promptGenPlugin, elevenlabsPlugin, openaiPlugin, composePlugin, cliPlugin
  ],
  pluginConfigs: {}
});
export * from "./plugins";                    // plugin instances + type namespaces
export const createApp = framework.createApp; // Layer-3 app factory
export const createPlugin = framework.createPlugin;
export { defineBuild } from "./plugins/buildfile";
```

Layer 3 — consumer apps (and src/bin.ts, the `moku` bin):

```ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/ai";
const app = createApp({});           // options: { plugins?, config?, pluginConfigs?, onReady?, onError?, onStart?, onStop? }
await app.start();
// ... app.runner / app.voiceover / app.cli / app.limits ...
await app.stop();
```

Key facts:
- Regular plugin APIs mount on the app BY NAME: app.registry, app.buildfile,
  app.runner, app.voiceover, app.translate, app.promptGen, app.elevenlabs, app.openai,
  app.compose, app.cli. Core APIs mount too (app.limits, ...). There is NO
  `app.plugins.<name>` indirection.
- App base methods: start(), stop(), emit(), require(), has(). There is NO `app.on` —
  bus-event subscription is a plugin concern (see §5, §10).
- Every regular plugin's ctx carries the injected core APIs: ctx.journal, ctx.store,
  ctx.limits, ctx.log, ctx.env.
- createApp's `pluginConfigs` is typed to REGULAR plugins only. Core-plugin config
  (journal/store/limits) can only be overridden where createCore is called; the
  framework passes `pluginConfigs: {}`, so those defaults are fixed for Layer-3
  consumers at M0.

================================================================================
2. PUBLIC PACKAGE SURFACE (@moku-labs/ai)
================================================================================

Value exports:
- createApp, createPlugin, defineBuild
- Plugin instances: buildfilePlugin, cliPlugin, composePlugin, elevenlabsPlugin,
  journalPlugin, limitsPlugin, openaiPlugin, promptGenPlugin, registryPlugin,
  runnerPlugin, storePlugin, translatePlugin, voiceoverPlugin
- Error classes (values, via namespaces): Elevenlabs.RetryableProviderError,
  Elevenlabs.TerminalProviderError, Elevenlabs.FlaggedProviderError, and the same three
  names under Openai.*
- Cli.EXIT_CODES (const object)

Type namespaces (import type { X } from "@moku-labs/ai"; access as X.TypeName):
- Journal, Store, Limits, Buildfile, Runner, Voiceover, Translate, PromptGen,
  Elevenlabs, Openai, Compose, Cli
(registry is Nano tier and ships no types.ts — its 4-method surface is declared once as
`RegistryApi` in `src/plugins/registry/index.ts`, and each dependent's types.ts
re-exports it: `export type { RegistryApi } from "../registry"`.)

Package entry: ESM + CJS with bundled .d.ts. Bin: `"moku": "./dist/bin.mjs"`.
Dependencies: @moku-labs/common 0.3.0, @moku-labs/core 1.5.0, better-sqlite3, openai,
yaml, zod.

================================================================================
3. CORE PLUGINS
================================================================================

Core plugins are registered in createCoreConfig (Layer 1). They declare no events, no
dependencies, and expose their APIs as ctx.* on every regular plugin's context and on
the app.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3.1 journal — ctx.journal (Complex tier)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Durable SQLite WAL ledger: one `runs` row per invocation, one `items` row per asset
(state machine queued → dispatching → done | failed | flagged), one `attempts` row per
provider call. Pragmas: journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=FULL, fullfsync=1, busy_timeout;
every write inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Driver seam: bun:sqlite on Bun, better-sqlite3 on
Node (selected via `typeof Bun`). Metadata only — no payload columns exist, so prompts
and bodies are structurally impossible to journal. Lifecycle: onStart opens driver +
schema + checkpoint timer; onStop checkpoints and closes. API methods throw
"[ai] Journal is not open.\n  Call app.start() before using the journal." pre-start.

Types (src/plugins/journal/types.ts):

```ts
export type Config = {
  path: string;                 // default ".moku/journal.db"
  checkpointIntervalMs: number; // default 30_000 (wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) cadence; unref()'d timer)
  busyTimeoutMs: number;        // default 5000
};

export type State = {
  driver: SqliteDriver | null;                          // open connection; null until onStart
  checkpointTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null;
};

export type RunStatus = "active" | "done" | "failed" | "paused" | "budget-stopped";
export type ItemStatus = "queued" | "dispatching" | "done" | "failed" | "flagged";
export type ErrorClass =
  | "http-5xx" | "http-429" | "timeout" | "network" | "http-4xx" | "content-policy" | "unknown";
export type AttemptOutcome = "done" | "retryable-error" | "terminal-error" | "flagged";

export type RunRow = {
  id: string;
  createdAt: number;
  status: RunStatus;
  glob: string;
  maxCostUsd: number | null;   // null = uncapped
  finishedAt: number | null;
};

export type ItemIntent = {
  planningKey: string;         // sha256(canonicalJson({ task, input, params }))
  buildFile: string;
  task: string;
  provider: string;
  packVersion: string | null;
  estimatedCostUsd: number;
};

export type ItemRow = ItemIntent & {
  id: string;
  runId: string;
  status: ItemStatus;
  artifactKey: string | null;
  contentHash: string | null;
  actualCostUsd: number | null;
  attemptCount: number;
  updatedAt: number;
};

export type GateResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: "budget" | "duplicate" };

export type RunTotals = {
  total: number; queued: number; dispatching: number; done: number;
  failed: number; flagged: number;
  spendUsd: number;               // sum of done items' actual cost
  estimatedRemainingUsd: number;  // sum of queued+dispatching estimates
};

export type AttemptStart = { provider: string; account: string; startedAt: number };
export type AttemptEnd = {
  endedAt: number; outcome: AttemptOutcome; errorClass?: ErrorClass; costUsd?: number;
};
export type RunSnapshot = { run: RunRow; totals: RunTotals; recentItems: ItemRow[] };
export type ItemFilter = { status?: ItemStatus; limit?: number; afterUpdatedAt?: number };

export type JournalApi = {
  openRun(opts: { glob: string; maxCostUsd?: number }): RunRow;
  getRun(runId: string): RunRow | undefined;
  latestResumableRun(): RunRow | undefined;   // latest "active" | "paused" | "budget-stopped"
  insertItems(runId: string, items: ItemIntent[]): ItemRow[];  // idempotent per (runId, planningKey)
  requeueDispatching(runId: string): number;  // crash-resume: dispatching → queued, returns count
  gateToDispatching(itemId: string): GateResult; // THE atomic budget+dedup gate (one transaction)
  recordAttempt(itemId: string, attempt: AttemptStart): number;
  finishAttempt(attemptId: number, end: AttemptEnd): void;
  commitDone(itemId: string,
    result: { actualCostUsd: number; artifactKey: string; contentHash: string; mimeType?: string }): void;
  findDoneArtifact(artifactKey: string): { contentHash: string; mimeType: string | null } | undefined;
  reuseDone(itemId: string, artifact: { contentHash: string; mimeType: string | null }): void;
  setAttemptJob(attemptId: number, job: { externalId?: string; jobState: "submitted" | "done" | "failed" | "expired" }): void;
  findLiveJob(artifactKey: string): { externalId: string } | undefined;
  latestRun(): RunRow | undefined;
  getItem(runId: string, planningKey: string): ItemRow | undefined;
  markFailed(itemId: string, result: { errorClass: ErrorClass; terminal: boolean }): void;
    // terminal:true → failed; terminal:false → back to queued, attemptCount++
  markFlagged(itemId: string): void;          // content-policy terminal, never re-queued
  setRunStatus(runId: string, status: RunStatus): void; // terminal statuses record finishedAt
  totals(runId: string): RunTotals;
  listItems(runId: string, filter?: ItemFilter): ItemRow[]; // oldest-updated first
  readSnapshot(runId: string): RunSnapshot;   // own short-lived connection — safe from a 2nd process
  checkpoint(): void;                          // manual PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)
};
```

Schema (schema.ts): tables `runs`, `items` (UNIQUE (run_id, planning_key); index
(run_id, status)), `attempts`. Created idempotently on onStart.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3.2 store — ctx.store (Standard tier)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Content-addressed store on the local filesystem. Objects at {dir}/{hash[0..2]}/{hash}.
Write protocol: unique tmp file in the shard dir → fsync(file) → rename(tmp, final) →
fsync(parent dir). First-committer-wins dedup (existing hash = no-op success; EEXIST on
rename = success). Reads recompute the hash and throw on mismatch. Hashes are validated
64-char lowercase sha256 hex (blocks path traversal). No lifecycle hooks; root dir is
created lazily on first put. The store dir is gitignored (may embed prompts/PII).

Types (src/plugins/store/types.ts):

```ts
export type Config = {
  dir: string;      // default ".moku/store"
  algo: "sha256";   // fixed at M0; forward-compat option
};
export type State = { rootEnsured: boolean };
export type PutResult = { hash: string; path: string; existed: boolean };
export type GcResult = { removed: number; bytesFreed: number };

export type StoreApi = {
  put(content: Uint8Array): Promise<PutResult>;   // durable when resolved
  has(hash: string): Promise<boolean>;
  pathOf(hash: string): string;                    // sync; throws not-found
  read(hash: string): Promise<Uint8Array>;         // integrity re-verified on every read
  hashOf(content: Uint8Array): string;             // hash without writing (planning-time identity)
  gc(keep: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<GcResult>; // sweep everything not in keep; skips .tmp-*
};
```

Pinned errors: "[ai] Store object not found for hash <hash>." and
"[ai] Store integrity check failed for <hash>." (corrupt object — delete + re-run).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3.3 limits — ctx.limits (Standard tier)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Per-lane admission control; lane key "{task}/{provider}/{account}" (account is always
"default" at M0). Three independent guards per lane: token bucket (rpm), FIFO
concurrency gate, circuit breaker (opens after breakerThreshold consecutive retryable
failures; half-open single-probe after breakerCooldownMs; any outcome settles the
probe). Timer-free: refill/breaker transitions are lazy timestamp math. Lane state is
created lazily on first acquire/reportOutcome. Pending waiters die with the process —
safe because gated work stays journal-queued/dispatching and resumes.

Types (src/plugins/limits/types.ts):

```ts
export type LaneConfig = {
  rpm: number;               // default 60 (also bucket capacity)
  concurrency: number;       // default 4
  breakerThreshold: number;  // default 5
  breakerCooldownMs: number; // default 30_000
};
export type Config = {
  defaults: LaneConfig;
  lanes: Record<string, Partial<LaneConfig>>; // keys: exact lane OR "{task}/{provider}" prefix
};
export type LaneState = {
  tokens: number; lastRefillAt: number; inFlight: number;
  waiters: Array<() => void>; consecutiveFailures: number;
  openUntil: number; probing: boolean;
};
export type State = { lanes: Map<string, LaneState> };
export type LaneSnapshot = {
  lane: string; tokens: number; inFlight: number; waiting: number;
  breaker: "closed" | "open" | "half-open";
};

export type LimitsApi = {
  acquire(lane: string, opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ release: () => void }>;
    // waits: breaker closed (or probe slot) → token → concurrency slot (FIFO).
    // release() must be called exactly once (no-op after the first).
    // Rejects IMMEDIATELY with an Error tagged `reason: "breaker-open"` when open.
    // Abort during the wait rejects with signal.reason; nothing leaks (token refunded,
    // waiter dequeued, probe slot released).
  reportOutcome(lane: string, outcome: "ok" | "retryable-error"): void;
    // "ok" closes/resets; "retryable-error" advances toward open.
    // Do NOT report terminal 4xx — deterministic, not a health signal. Never throws.
  laneConfig(lane: string): LaneConfig;   // exact > prefix > defaults; pure lookup
  snapshot(lane: string): LaneSnapshot;   // lazily refills before reading; untouched lane = pristine
  lanes(): string[];                       // lanes touched by at least one acquire/reportOutcome
};
```

================================================================================
4. REGULAR PLUGINS
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.1 registry — app.registry (Nano tier; no config, no events, no types.ts)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dumb two-level map: task → provider → handler, stored/returned as `unknown` — the
registry never inspects what it transports. Provider plugins register in onInit via
ctx.require(registryPlugin); task plugins resolve + guard + perform their ONE audited
cast. PERMANENT CONSTRAINT: must stay a regular plugin (core-plugin ctx has no
require/depends, and providers need `depends: [registryPlugin]`).

```ts
// API (inferred; declared once as RegistryApi in registry/index.ts, re-exported by dependents)
register(task: string, provider: string, handler: unknown): void;
  // throws on duplicate: `[ai] Provider "<provider>" is already registered for task "<task>".
  //   Register each task/provider pair exactly once.`
resolve(task: string, provider: string): unknown;   // undefined when unregistered; never throws
providers(task: string): string[];  // registration order; [0] is the task's default provider
tasks(): string[];                  // registration order
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.2 buildfile — app.buildfile (Standard tier; stateless pure compiler; no deps)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The build-file front door: parses *.moku.yaml and defineBuild() TS modules through ONE
zod schema (schema.ts). BuildSpec/BuildItem are z.infer of the zod objects; the JSON
Schema is z.toJSONSchema of the same objects — validator, static types, and editor
autocomplete can never drift. Deliberately does NOT consult registry (provider
existence is checked by the runner at dispatch) — `moku validate` works offline.

Types (src/plugins/buildfile/types.ts):

```ts
export type BuildItem = z.infer<typeof buildItemSchema>;
// = { task: string; id?: string; provider?: string; input: Record<string, unknown>;
//     params?: Record<string, unknown>; pack?: { name: string; version: string } }
export type BuildSpec = z.infer<typeof buildSpecSchema>;
// = { version: 1; name: string; defaults?: { provider?: string; maxAttempts?: number };
//     items: BuildItem[]; itemsFrom?: string }
export type Config = {
  defaultGlob: string;  // default "**/*.moku.yaml"
  schemaPath: string;   // default ".moku/build.schema.json"
};
export type CompiledBuild = { file: string; spec: BuildSpec }; // file = path or "<inline>"
export type BuildfileSource = { path: string } | { text: string; lang: "yaml" };

export type BuildfileApi = {
  compile(source: BuildfileSource): Promise<CompiledBuild>;
    // .ts path → dynamic import, default export must be a defineBuild() result;
    // other paths → YAML. itemsFrom NDJSON (resolved relative to the build file) is
    // appended to spec.items at compile time.
    // throws: `[ai] Build file "<label>" is invalid.\n  <zod path>: <message>.`
  loadGlob(pattern?: string): Promise<CompiledBuild[]>;  // sorted path order
    // empty match throws: `[ai] No build files matched "<pattern>".\n  Run "moku new" to create one.`
  jsonSchema(): Record<string, unknown>;
  template(opts: { name: string }): string;
    // modeline + $schema: key + minimal valid spec + one commented example per M0 task
};
```

Standalone helper (also re-exported from "@moku-labs/ai"):

```ts
export function defineBuild(spec: BuildSpec): BuildSpec;
// pure factory; validates through the exact schema the YAML loader uses
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.3 runner — app.runner (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin, buildfilePlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The durable orchestrator. Per-item pipeline:
1. Plan — buildfile.loadGlob(files); order items by $ref; resolve provider (item.provider →
   defaults.provider → registry.providers(task)[0]); planning key =
   sha256(canonicalJson({ task, input, params })) (provider excluded; $ref → target planning
   key, $file → file sha256); artifact key = same over { task, provider, packVersion, input,
   params } ($ref → target artifact key); request = { ...input, params }; estimate via
   handler.estimate(request); journal.insertItems as queued with label/buildName/artifactKey.
1a. Reuse — journal.findDoneArtifact(artifactKey) from ANY run, bytes in store → reuseDone
   ($0, no provider call).
1b. References — wait for $ref targets; not done → item stays queued, run ends paused;
   $ref/$file resolve to { path, mimeType, hash }.
2. Admit — limits.acquire("{task}/{provider}/default", { signal }); abort/breaker-open
   exits cleanly (item stays queued).
3. Gate — journal.gateToDispatching(itemId): budget + dedup + transition in ONE
   transaction. "budget" → graceful budget-stop drain; "duplicate" → release slot.
4. Execute — registry.resolve(task, provider) narrowed by isExecutableHandler() (the
   runner's single audited cast); journal.recordAttempt; submit+poll when the handler has both
   (job id journaled via setAttemptJob before any wait; a live job for the same artifact key
   is adopted, never re-submitted; poll every pollIntervalMs; expired after jobTimeoutMs),
   else handler.execute(request, { signal }).
5. Classify — classifyError maps thrown errors onto the taxonomy;
   limits.reportOutcome("ok" | "retryable-error").
6. Persist — normalize (body | audio | image | video | text), store.put(bytes) THEN
   journal.commitDone(itemId, { actualCostUsd, artifactKey, contentHash, mimeType }).
7. Report — item record to events() subscribers; coalesced run:progress on the bus.

Named constraints: per-item events NEVER on the bus; redaction boundary (raw
prompts/bodies never reach ctx.journal — HandlerRequest is never journaled); up to
maxActiveRuns runs per process (default 1; above the cap run()/resume() throws);
lanes are shared across runs; the same artifact key in two runs is submitted once;
app.stop() pauses active runs (onStop) and waits for them before the journal closes.

Types (src/plugins/runner/types.ts):

```ts
export type Config = {
  maxAttempts: number;     // default 3 (per build file overridable via defaults.maxAttempts)
  retryBaseMs: number;     // default 1000 (exponential, jittered 50–100%; Retry-After honored when larger)
  eventBufferSize: number; // default 10_000 (events() per-consumer buffer)
  pollIntervalMs: number;  // default 5000
  jobTimeoutMs: number;    // default 1_800_000
  maxActiveRuns: number;   // default 1 (runs driven at once in this process)
};

export type RunOptions = { files?: string; maxCostUsd?: number; dryRun?: boolean };
export type RunResultStatus = "done" | "failed" | "paused" | "budget-stopped";
export type RunResult = { runId: string; status: RunResultStatus; totals: RunTotals };
export type EstimateLine = { task: string; provider: string; items: number; usd: number };
export type EstimateResult = { lines: EstimateLine[]; totalUsd: number };
export type RunStatusReport = { runId: string; status: string; totals: RunTotals; updatedAt: number };

export type RunEvent =
  | { type: "item:queued"; itemId: string; task: string; provider: string }
  | { type: "item:dispatching"; itemId: string }
  | { type: "item:done"; itemId: string; costUsd: number; contentHash: string }
  | { type: "item:retry"; itemId: string; errorClass: ErrorClass; attempt: number }
  | { type: "item:failed"; itemId: string; errorClass: ErrorClass }
  | { type: "item:flagged"; itemId: string }
  | { type: "overflow"; dropped: number }
  | { type: "progress"; totals: RunTotals }
  | { type: "terminal"; status: RunResultStatus; totals: RunTotals };

export type RunnerEvents = {
  "run:progress": { runId: string; total: number; done: number; failed: number;
                    flagged: number; spendUsd: number };
  "run:done": { runId: string; totals: RunTotals };
  "run:failed": { runId: string; error: string };
  "run:budget-stop": { runId: string; spendUsd: number; maxCostUsd: number };
  "run:paused": { runId: string; drained: number };
};

export type HandlerRequest = Record<string, unknown>; // { ...item.input, params }
export type ResolvedFile = { path: string; mimeType: string; hash: string };
export type HandlerResult = {
  body?: Uint8Array; audio?: Uint8Array; image?: Uint8Array; video?: Uint8Array; text?: string;
  mimeType?: string; costUsd: number; meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type JobPoll =
  | { state: "pending" }
  | ({ state: "done" } & HandlerResult)
  | { state: "failed"; error: unknown };
export type ExecutableHandler = {
  estimate(request: HandlerRequest): { usd: number };
  execute?(request: HandlerRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<HandlerResult>;
  submit?(request: HandlerRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ jobId: string }>;
  poll?(jobId: string, request: HandlerRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<JobPoll>;
};
export type ExportResult = {
  runId: string; outDir: string; skipped: string[];
  files: Array<{ label: string; path: string; bytes: number; costUsd: number; mimeType: string }>;
};
export type ProviderErrorHint = {
  status?: number;
  kind?: "timeout" | "network" | "content-policy"; // overrides status-based inference
  retryAfterMs?: number;
};

export type State = {
  active: Map<string, ActiveRun>;
  subscribers: Set<Subscriber>;
  claims: Map<string, Claim>; // artifact key -> the item allowed to reach the provider
};

export type RunnerApi = {
  run(options: RunOptions, opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; onStart?: (runId: string) => void }): Promise<RunResult>;
    // dryRun → no journal writes, runId "dry-run", status "done", plan total in
    // totals.estimatedRemainingUsd. Throws only above maxActiveRuns;
    // in-run failures resolve { status: "failed" } after emitting run:failed.
  resume(opts?: { runId?: string; signal?: AbortSignal; onStart?: (runId: string) => void }): Promise<RunResult>;
    // requeueDispatching + idempotent re-plan; done items never re-billed.
  estimate(options: { files?: string }): Promise<EstimateResult>; // same math as the budget gate
  status(runId?: string): RunStatusReport; // given id, else active run, else latest resumable
  events(opts?: { runId?: string }): AsyncIterable<RunEvent>;
    // { runId }: that run only; no runId: every run until none is active. Every record carries runId.
    // per-consumer bounded queue; oldest ITEM records drop into one {type:"overflow"};
    // "progress" coalesces (latest wins); "terminal" is ALWAYS delivered last.
};
```

Retry taxonomy (contractual): http-5xx (status>=500) retry · http-429 retry
(Retry-After honored when larger) · timeout (kind) retry · network (kind) retry ·
http-4xx (except 429) terminal failed · unknown (no hint) terminal failed after one
attempt · content-policy (kind) terminal flagged.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.4 voiceover — app.voiceover (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Owns the "voiceover" task contract; providers implement + register it; this plugin
resolves, runtime-shape-guards, and performs the task's ONE audited cast. Also bundles
versioned template packs (packs/narration.ts): per-provider param presets merged UNDER
request params (request wins); pack version participates in artifact identity.

Contract (src/plugins/voiceover/contract.ts):

```ts
export type VoiceoverRequest = {
  text: string;
  voice: string;                     // provider-scoped voice id/name
  language?: string;                 // BCP-47 hint
  model?: string;
  format?: "mp3" | "wav" | "ogg";    // defaulted from config.defaultFormat when omitted
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;  // resolved pack values merged upstream
};
export type VoiceoverResult = {
  audio: Uint8Array;
  mimeType: string;                  // audio/mpeg | audio/wav | audio/ogg
  costUsd: number;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;    // metadata only — never a payload echo
};
export type VoiceoverHandler = {
  estimate(request: VoiceoverRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: VoiceoverRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<VoiceoverResult>;
};
```

Config + API (src/plugins/voiceover/types.ts):

```ts
export type Config = {
  defaultProvider: string;              // default "elevenlabs"
  defaultFormat: "mp3" | "wav" | "ogg"; // default "mp3"
};
export type VoiceoverApi = {
  generate(request: VoiceoverRequest,
    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; provider?: string }): Promise<VoiceoverResult>; // NOT journaled
  estimate(request: VoiceoverRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[]; // = registry.providers("voiceover")
};
```

Unknown-provider error (same shape for translate/promptGen with their task names):
`[ai] No voiceover provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.5 translate — app.translate (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Contract (src/plugins/translate/contract.ts):

```ts
export type TranslateRequest = {
  text: string;
  targetLang: string;   // BCP-47
  sourceLang?: string;  // omitted = auto-detect
  model?: string;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type TranslateResult = {
  text: string;
  detectedSourceLang?: string;
  costUsd: number;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type TranslateHandler = {
  estimate(request: TranslateRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: TranslateRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<TranslateResult>;
};
```

```ts
export type Config = { defaultProvider: string }; // default "openai"
export type TranslateApi = {
  generate(request: TranslateRequest,
    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; provider?: string }): Promise<TranslateResult>; // NOT journaled
  estimate(request: TranslateRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[];
};
```

Malformed-registration error: `[ai] Registered translate provider "<name>" does not
implement TranslateHandler.\n  It must expose estimate() and execute() functions.`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.6 promptGen — app.promptGen (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NAMING: plugin/api name is camelCase `promptGen`; the registry/task key used in build
files and register() calls is kebab-case `"prompt-gen"`. Exists at M0 primarily to back
`compose` (which calls this facade instead of touching the registry).

Contract (src/plugins/promptGen/contract.ts):

```ts
export type PromptGenRequest = {
  prompt: string;
  system?: string;
  model?: string;
  temperature?: number;              // provider maps/clamps as needed
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type PromptGenResult = {
  text: string;
  costUsd: number;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type PromptGenHandler = {
  estimate(request: PromptGenRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: PromptGenRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<PromptGenResult>;
};
```

```ts
export type Config = { defaultProvider: string }; // default "openai"
export type PromptGenApi = {
  generate(request: PromptGenRequest,
    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; provider?: string }): Promise<PromptGenResult>; // NOT journaled
  estimate(request: PromptGenRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[];
};
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.7 elevenlabs — app.elevenlabs (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Provider adapter for ElevenLabs. Thin fetch client, no SDK. onInit registers
("voiceover", "elevenlabs") → createVoiceoverHandler(ctx). POST
/v1/text-to-speech/{voiceId}?output_format=... (mp3→mp3_44100_128, wav→pcm_44100,
ogg→ogg_44100). API key resolved via ctx.env at request time only (info()/estimate()
are key-free). estimate = text.length × per-character price for the resolved model
(request.model ?? config.defaultModel); unpriced models estimate $0.

```ts
export type Config = {
  apiKeyEnv: string;      // default "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY"
  baseUrl: string;        // default "https://api.elevenlabs.io"
  defaultModel: string;   // default "eleven_multilingual_v2"
  timeoutMs: number;      // default 60_000 (AbortSignal.timeout merged with caller signal)
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number>; // USD/char by model, merged over bundled table
};
export type State = { prices: Record<string, number> | null }; // lazy effective table

export type ElevenlabsApi = {
  info(): { provider: "elevenlabs"; configured: boolean; models: string[] }; // never throws
};

// Error classes (exported values under the Elevenlabs namespace):
export class RetryableProviderError extends Error {
  readonly status: number | undefined;                 // 5xx or 429
  readonly kind: "timeout" | "network" | undefined;
  readonly retryAfterMs: number | undefined;           // parsed Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date)
  constructor(message: string,
    hint: { status?: number; kind?: "timeout" | "network"; retryAfterMs?: number });
}
export class TerminalProviderError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;                             // 4xx except 429
  constructor(message: string, status: number);
}
export class FlaggedProviderError extends Error {
  readonly kind: "content-policy" = "content-policy";
  constructor(message: string);
}
```

Bundled prices (USD/char): eleven_multilingual_v2 0.0003 · eleven_turbo_v2_5 0.000_15 ·
eleven_flash_v2_5 0.000_06 · eleven_monolingual_v1 0.0003.
Missing-key error (before any network call):
`[ai] ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv to the variable that holds your key.`
Logs (redacted): elevenlabs:voiceover:done (info) / elevenlabs:voiceover:failed (warn).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.8 openai — app.openai (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Provider adapter via the official `openai` SDK (fetch-based; SDK retries disabled with
maxRetries: 0 — the runner owns retry timing). onInit registers THREE handlers:
("voiceover","openai") tts/handler.ts · ("translate","openai") translate/handler.ts ·
("prompt-gen","openai") prompt-gen/handler.ts. Lazy client (constructed on first
execute; info()/estimate() never touch it). Chat estimates use a chars/4 token
heuristic; actual cost is usage-based when reported, heuristic fallback otherwise.
Translate uses a fixed system prompt with temperature: 0 and never sets
detectedSourceLang. A non-null `refusal` in a chat response → FlaggedProviderError.
Voiceover format mapping: mp3→mp3 (audio/mpeg), wav→wav (audio/wav), ogg→opus (audio/ogg).

```ts
export type Config = {
  apiKeyEnv: string;                   // default "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  baseUrl?: string;                    // optional; proxies / OpenAI-compatible endpoints
  models: { tts: string; chat: string }; // default { tts: "gpt-4o-mini-tts", chat: "gpt-4o-mini" }
  timeoutMs: number;                   // default 60_000 (SDK client timeout)
  priceOverrides: Record<string, { inputPerM?: number; outputPerM?: number; ttsPerMChars?: number }>;
};
export type PriceTable = Record<string, { inputPerM?: number; outputPerM?: number; ttsPerMChars?: number }>;
export type State = { client: OpenaiClient | null; prices: PriceTable | null };

export type OpenaiApi = {
  info(): { provider: "openai"; configured: boolean; models: { tts: string; chat: string } };
};

// OpenaiClient is a STRUCTURAL alias covering exactly the two SDK calls used
// (audio.speech.create, chat.completions.create) — survives .d.ts bundling, trivially mockable.

// Error classes (exported values under the Openai namespace) — same taxonomy shape:
export class RetryableProviderError extends Error {
  readonly status: number | undefined;
  readonly kind: "timeout" | "network" | undefined;
  readonly retryAfterMs: number | undefined;
  constructor(message: string,
    hint?: { status?: number; kind?: "timeout" | "network"; retryAfterMs?: number });
}
export class TerminalProviderError extends Error {
  readonly status: number | undefined;
  constructor(message: string, status?: number);
}
export class FlaggedProviderError extends Error { readonly kind = "content-policy" as const; }
```

Bundled prices: gpt-4o-mini $0.15/M in · $0.60/M out — gpt-4o $2.50/M in · $10/M out —
gpt-4o-mini-tts $15/M chars — tts-1 $15/M chars — tts-1-hd $30/M chars.
Missing-key error: `[ai] OPENAI_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv
to the variable that holds your key.`
Logs (redacted): openai:{tts|translate|prompt-gen}:{done|failed}.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.9 compose — app.compose (Standard tier; depends: [buildfilePlugin, promptGenPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Natural-language prompt → validated build file. Pipeline: system prompt embedding
buildfile.jsonSchema() + per-task input docs → promptGen.generate({ prompt, system },
{ provider, signal }) → strip defensive ```yaml fence → buildfile.compile({ text,
lang: "yaml" }) → on failure re-prompt with the validation issue, up to
maxRepairAttempts additional times → apply opts.name override → emit. GUARANTEE:
compose can never return an invalid build file. Never writes files — the CLI (or the
caller) persists `text`. Never touches registry (the audited cast stays with the task
plugin). costUsd accumulates across ALL attempts, failed ones included.

```ts
export type Config = {
  provider: string;          // default "openai" — passed to promptGen.generate
  maxRepairAttempts: number; // default 2 — ADDITIONAL attempts; total = 1 + maxRepairAttempts
};
export type ComposeResult = { spec: BuildSpec; text: string; costUsd: number };
export type ComposeApi = {
  compose(opts: {
    prompt: string;
    emit: "build" | "script"; // "build" = YAML (modeline + $schema key); "script" = defineBuild() TS module
    name?: string;            // spec.name override, applied after validation
    signal?: AbortSignal;     // forwarded to every promptGen.generate call
  }): Promise<ComposeResult>;
};
```

Exhaustion error: `[ai] Compose could not produce a valid build file after <n> attempts.
  Refine the prompt or write the build file manually with "moku new".`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.10 cli — app.cli (Complex tier; depends: [runnerPlugin, buildfilePlugin, composePlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The `moku` command surface. No lifecycle, no state (ratified OQ1). argv parsed with
node:util parseArgs (strict; kebab flags → camelCase keys; boolean flags recorded as
the literal "true"). All rendering through @moku-labs/common/cli's BrandConsole (MC1);
plain mode when config.plain || !TTY || NO_COLOR (via ctx.env). dispatch() NEVER calls
process.exit — src/bin.ts owns the process (createApp → start → dispatch → stop → exit).
SIGINT wiring (run/compose): first Ctrl-C aborts the AbortSignal (clean pause/drain);
the once-listener then falls through to Node's default on a second Ctrl-C.

```ts
export type Config = { plain: boolean }; // default false

export const EXIT_CODES = {
  ok: 0, failure: 1, validation: 2, usage: 3, paused: 4, budgetStop: 5
} as const;

export type CliApi = {
  dispatch(argv: string[]): Promise<number>; // argv excludes node/script prefix
  commands(): CommandTree;                    // mountable tree for a future umbrella CLI
};
export type CommandTree = {
  name: string; description: string;
  commands: Array<{ name: string; description: string; flags: Record<string, string> }>;
};
// Also exported under the Cli namespace: CommandContext, CommandDefinition,
// CommandFlags, CommandFlagSpec.
```

Commands:
- moku new [name] — writes template({ name }) to <name>.moku.yaml (default "build") +
  jsonSchema() at the modeline path; refuses overwrite (exit 1).
- moku validate [glob] — loadGlob; exit 0 all valid, 2 on first invalid/empty match.
- moku estimate [glob] — runner.estimate breakdown box; exit 0.
- moku run [glob] [--max-cost <usd>] [--dry-run] — runner.run + events() progress;
  exits: done→0, failed→1, paused→4, budget-stopped→5, bad --max-cost→3.
- moku status [runId] [--follow] — status snapshot; --follow polls
  journal.readSnapshot every 1s (short-lived reads — WAL checkpoint-starvation
  mitigation) until terminal. Exit 0.
- moku compose "<prompt>" [--emit build|script] [--out <path>] — compose.compose;
  writes --out or prints; exits 0 ok, 3 usage, 2 repair-exhausted, else 1.

================================================================================
5. COMPLETE EVENT CATALOG
================================================================================

Plugin-bus events (declared ONLY by runner; every other plugin declares none):

| Event            | Payload                                                              | When |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|------|
| run:progress     | { runId: string; total: number; done: number; failed: number; flagged: number; spendUsd: number } | coalesced, ≤1 per 500ms |
| run:done         | { runId: string; totals: RunTotals }                                  | run completed |
| run:failed       | { runId: string; error: string }                                      | unrecoverable run error |
| run:budget-stop  | { runId: string; spendUsd: number; maxCostUsd: number }               | budget ceiling; run drained |
| run:paused       | { runId: string; drained: number }                                    | clean pause completed |

Subscription: a plugin declares `depends: [runnerPlugin]` and a `hooks` map (typed via
dependency events). There is NO app.on. Hook dispatch is sequential-await — which is
exactly why per-item events are kept off the bus.

```ts
const watcher = createPlugin("watcher", {
  depends: [runnerPlugin],
  hooks: ctx => ({
    "run:progress": payload => ctx.log.info("progress", payload),
    "run:budget-stop": ({ runId, spendUsd, maxCostUsd }) =>
      ctx.log.warn("budget stop", { runId, spendUsd, maxCostUsd })
  })
});
```

Per-item stream records — app.runner.events(opts?), AsyncIterable<RunEvent>, active runs only
(closed empty stream otherwise). Every record also carries runId:

| Record            | Fields                                | When |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------|------|
| item:queued       | itemId, task, provider                 | item enters the pipeline |
| item:dispatching  | itemId                                 | passed the atomic gate |
| item:done         | itemId, costUsd, contentHash           | artifact stored + committed |
| item:retry        | itemId, errorClass, attempt            | retryable failure; re-queued with backoff |
| item:failed       | itemId, errorClass                     | terminal failure |
| item:flagged      | itemId                                 | content policy (terminal) |
| overflow          | dropped                                | buffer overflowed; oldest item records coalesced |
| progress          | totals                                 | coalesced totals (latest unconsumed wins) |
| terminal          | status, totals                         | ALWAYS the last record delivered |

Structured log events (ctx.log; diagnostics, not bus events): runner:stale-item,
elevenlabs:voiceover:done/failed, openai:tts:done/failed, openai:translate:done/failed,
openai:prompt-gen:done/failed.

================================================================================
6. CONFIG SCHEMA — EVERY FIELD
================================================================================

Global framework Config: {} (empty, ratified). Per-plugin (defaults shipped in each
plugin's index.ts; override REGULAR plugins via createApp({ pluginConfigs })):

journal (core — createCore-level only):
  path: string = ".moku/journal.db"            — journal DB file; parents created on start
  checkpointIntervalMs: number = 30_000        — wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) cadence (unref'd)
  busyTimeoutMs: number = 5000                 — SQLite busy_timeout (also for readSnapshot conns)

store (core — createCore-level only):
  dir: string = ".moku/store"                  — CAS root (gitignored)
  algo: "sha256" = "sha256"                    — fixed at M0

limits (core — createCore-level only):
  defaults.rpm: number = 60                    — requests/minute per lane (bucket capacity)
  defaults.concurrency: number = 4             — in-flight ceiling per lane
  defaults.breakerThreshold: number = 5        — consecutive retryable failures to open
  defaults.breakerCooldownMs: number = 30_000  — open duration before half-open probe
  lanes: Record<string, Partial<LaneConfig>> = {} — exact-lane or "{task}/{provider}" prefix overrides

registry: no config.

buildfile:
  defaultGlob: string = "**/*.moku.yaml"       — used when loadGlob gets no pattern
  schemaPath: string = ".moku/build.schema.json" — where moku new writes the JSON Schema

runner:
  maxAttempts: number = 3                      — per-item retry ceiling (build defaults.maxAttempts overrides)
  retryBaseMs: number = 1000                   — backoff base (exponential, jittered 50–100%)
  eventBufferSize: number = 10_000             — events() per-consumer buffer
  maxActiveRuns: number = 1                    — runs driven at once in this process

voiceover:
  defaultProvider: string = "elevenlabs"
  defaultFormat: "mp3" | "wav" | "ogg" = "mp3"

translate:
  defaultProvider: string = "openai"

promptGen:
  defaultProvider: string = "openai"

elevenlabs:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY"
  baseUrl: string = "https://api.elevenlabs.io"
  defaultModel: string = "eleven_multilingual_v2"
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — USD/char by model

openai:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  baseUrl?: string = undefined                 — SDK default endpoint when omitted
  models: { tts: string; chat: string } = { tts: "gpt-4o-mini-tts", chat: "gpt-4o-mini" }
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000
  priceOverrides: Record<string, { inputPerM?: number; outputPerM?: number; ttsPerMChars?: number }> = {}

compose:
  provider: string = "openai"
  maxRepairAttempts: number = 2                — additional attempts; total = 1 + this

cli:
  plain: boolean = false                       — auto-true when !TTY or NO_COLOR (via ctx.env)

Environment variables: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY (names configurable via
apiKeyEnv; read via ctx.env at execute time only), NO_COLOR (CLI plain mode).

================================================================================
7. COMPLETE USAGE EXAMPLES
================================================================================

7.1 Durable run with budget, clean pause, live stream, and resume:

```ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/ai";

const app = createApp({});
await app.start();

const controller = new AbortController();
process.on("SIGINT", () => controller.abort());

const { totalUsd } = await app.runner.estimate({ files: "voice/*.moku.yaml" });
const runPromise = app.runner.run(
  { files: "voice/*.moku.yaml", maxCostUsd: totalUsd * 1.2 },
  { signal: controller.signal }
);

for await (const event of app.runner.events()) {
  if (event.type === "item:done") report(event.itemId, event.costUsd);
  if (event.type === "item:retry") warn(event.itemId, event.errorClass, event.attempt);
  if (event.type === "terminal") break;
}

const result = await runPromise;
if (result.status === "paused") {
  await app.runner.resume({ runId: result.runId }); // done items never re-billed
}
await app.stop();
```

7.2 One-off facades (NOT journaled — scripts/tests/experiments only):

```ts
const { configured } = app.elevenlabs.info();
if (!configured) throw new Error("Export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY first.");

const { usd } = app.voiceover.estimate({ text: "Welcome!", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM" });
const speech = await app.voiceover.generate(
  { text: "Welcome!", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", format: "ogg" },
  { provider: "elevenlabs" }
);
await Bun.write("welcome.ogg", speech.audio);

const translated = await app.translate.generate({ text: "Welcome!", targetLang: "ja" });
const tagline = await app.promptGen.generate(
  { prompt: "One-line tagline for a durable AI build system.", temperature: 0.7 },
  { provider: "openai" }
);
```

7.3 Natural language → build file → run (compose + cli split: compose produces text,
the caller persists it):

```ts
const { spec, text, costUsd } = await app.compose.compose({
  prompt: "Narrate a greeting in English, then translate it to Spanish.",
  emit: "build",
  name: "greeting"
});
await Bun.write("greeting.moku.yaml", text);
const result = await app.runner.run({ files: "greeting.moku.yaml", maxCostUsd: 1 });
```

7.4 Build files — YAML, NDJSON items, and typed TS:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=.moku/build.schema.json
$schema: .moku/build.schema.json
version: 1
name: "launch-assets"
defaults: { provider: elevenlabs, maxAttempts: 3 }
items:
  - task: voiceover
    id: intro-line
    input: { text: "Hello, world!", voice: "en-US-1" }
  - task: translate
    provider: openai
    input: { text: "Hello, world!", targetLang: "es" }
    params: { formality: high }        # part of the planning key
itemsFrom: extra-items.ndjson          # one BuildItem JSON object per line
```

```ts
// build.moku.ts — compile({ path: "build.moku.ts" }) imports the default export
import { defineBuild } from "@moku-labs/ai";
export default defineBuild({
  version: 1,
  name: "demo",
  items: [{ task: "voiceover", input: { text: "Hello, world!", voice: "en-US-1" } }]
});
```

7.5 Status from a second process (safe — readSnapshot opens its own short-lived
connection against the shared WAL journal file):

```ts
const report = app.runner.status();            // { runId, status, totals, updatedAt }
// or: moku status --follow
```

7.6 Direct journal/store/limits use from a custom plugin (full item lifecycle):

```ts
import { createPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

export const myPipelinePlugin = createPlugin("myPipeline", {
  api: ctx => ({
    async produceOne() {
      const run = ctx.journal.openRun({ glob: "assets/*.yaml", maxCostUsd: 10 });
      const [item] = ctx.journal.insertItems(run.id, [{
        planningKey: ctx.store.hashOf(new TextEncoder().encode("intent")),
        buildFile: "assets/one.yaml", task: "voiceover", provider: "elevenlabs",
        packVersion: null, estimatedCostUsd: 0.4
      }]);

      const gate = ctx.journal.gateToDispatching(item.id);
      if (!gate.ok) return ctx.log.warn("blocked", { reason: gate.reason }); // "budget" | "duplicate"

      const lane = "voiceover/elevenlabs/default";
      const { release } = await ctx.limits.acquire(lane);
      const attemptId = ctx.journal.recordAttempt(item.id, {
        provider: "elevenlabs", account: "default", startedAt: Date.now()
      });
      try {
        const body = await callProvider();
        const { hash } = await ctx.store.put(body);      // bytes FIRST
        ctx.limits.reportOutcome(lane, "ok");
        ctx.journal.finishAttempt(attemptId, { endedAt: Date.now(), outcome: "done", costUsd: 0.2 });
        ctx.journal.commitDone(item.id, { actualCostUsd: 0.2, artifactKey: hash, contentHash: hash });
        ctx.journal.setRunStatus(run.id, "done");
      } catch {
        ctx.limits.reportOutcome(lane, "retryable-error");
        ctx.journal.finishAttempt(attemptId, {
          endedAt: Date.now(), outcome: "retryable-error", errorClass: "http-5xx"
        });
        ctx.journal.markFailed(item.id, { errorClass: "http-5xx", terminal: false });
      } finally {
        release();
      }
    }
  })
});
```

7.7 Programmatic CLI dispatch:

```ts
import { Cli, createApp } from "@moku-labs/ai";
const app = createApp({ pluginConfigs: { cli: { plain: true } } });
await app.start();
const code = await app.cli.dispatch(["validate"]);
if (code !== Cli.EXIT_CODES.ok) { /* handle */ }
await app.stop();
```

================================================================================
8. ERROR HANDLING PATTERNS
================================================================================

All framework errors are plain Error subclasses at M0 (no custom error hierarchy
beyond the provider classes). Messages follow the pinned two-line format:
"[ai] <what happened>.\n  <how to fix it>."

Pattern 1 — provider error taxonomy (instanceof, per provider namespace):

```ts
import { Elevenlabs } from "@moku-labs/ai";
try {
  await app.voiceover.generate({ text: "Hi", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM" });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof Elevenlabs.RetryableProviderError) {
    // transient: 5xx / 429 / timeout / network — error.status, error.kind, error.retryAfterMs
  } else if (error instanceof Elevenlabs.FlaggedProviderError) {
    // content policy — do not re-queue
  } else if (error instanceof Elevenlabs.TerminalProviderError) {
    // deterministic 4xx — error.status
  } else throw error;
}
```

Pattern 2 — structural classification (how the runner does it; no class imports).
Provider errors carry ProviderErrorHint fields read by shape: `status?: number`,
`kind?: "timeout" | "network" | "content-policy"` (kind overrides status),
`retryAfterMs?: number`. An error with no hint classifies as "unknown" (terminal: a
programming error never re-runs a paid job); tag real transport failures kind "network".
Custom providers steer retry behavior by attaching these fields to thrown errors.

Pattern 3 — breaker-open (tag, not message):

```ts
try {
  const { release } = await ctx.limits.acquire(lane);
  // ... release() in finally
} catch (error) {
  if ((error as { reason?: string }).reason === "breaker-open") return; // skip / fail over
  throw error;
}
```

Pattern 4 — gate results are values, not throws:
`gateToDispatching` returns { ok: false, reason: "budget" | "duplicate" } — branch,
don't catch. Run-level failures also resolve (RunResult.status "failed") rather than
reject; run()/resume() throw only for caller mistakes (run already active, unknown
runId, no resumable run).

Pattern 5 — aborts are not errors. A caller-initiated AbortSignal abort propagates
unchanged (never reclassified, never breaker-reported); the runner turns it into
{ status: "paused" } after draining in-flight items.

Pinned message catalog (verbatim, interpolations in <>):
- [ai] Journal is not open.\n  Call app.start() before using the journal.
- [ai] Store object not found for hash <hash>.
- [ai] Store integrity check failed for <hash>.
- [ai] Provider "<provider>" is already registered for task "<task>".\n  Register each task/provider pair exactly once.
- [ai] Build file "<label>" is invalid.\n  <path>: <message>.
- [ai] No build files matched "<pattern>".\n  Run "moku new" to create one.
- [ai] No voiceover provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.
  (same shape for translate / prompt-gen)
- [ai] Registered translate provider "<name>" does not implement TranslateHandler.\n  It must expose estimate() and execute() functions.
  (same shape per task contract)
- [ai] ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv to the variable that holds your key.
- [ai] OPENAI_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv to the variable that holds your key.
- [ai] Compose could not produce a valid build file after <n> attempts.\n  Refine the prompt or write the build file manually with "moku new".

================================================================================
9. DEPENDENCY GRAPH + INITIALIZATION ORDER
================================================================================

Core plugins (Layer 1, before all regular plugins):
  log → env → journal → store → limits          (no inter-dependencies; injected as ctx.*)

Regular plugins (Layer 2 registration order in src/index.ts — every plugin after
everything it depends on):

  1. registry      (deps: none)   Nano
  2. buildfile     (deps: none)   Standard
  3. runner        (deps: registry, buildfile)          Complex
  4. voiceover     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  5. translate     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  6. promptGen     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  7. elevenlabs    (deps: registry) — onInit registers ("voiceover","elevenlabs")   Complex
  8. openai        (deps: registry) — onInit registers ("voiceover","openai"),
                    ("translate","openai"), ("prompt-gen","openai")                  Complex
  9. compose       (deps: buildfile, promptGen)          Standard
 10. cli           (deps: runner, buildfile, compose)    Complex

ASCII graph (A --> B means A depends on B):

  runner ----> registry        voiceover --> registry     elevenlabs --> registry
  runner ----> buildfile       translate --> registry     openai -----> registry
  compose ---> buildfile       promptGen --> registry
  compose ---> promptGen
  cli -------> runner          cli --------> buildfile    cli --------> compose

Provider registration happens in onInit, so by the time app.start() resolves every
task facade sees its providers. Registration order makes elevenlabs the first (and
therefore default) voiceover provider; openai is the only translate/prompt-gen
provider at M0. Wave history: W1 registry+buildfile · W2 runner+voiceover+translate+
promptGen · W3 elevenlabs+openai+compose · W4 cli.

================================================================================
10. EXTENSION PATTERNS
================================================================================

10.1 Custom provider for an existing task (most common):

```ts
import { createApp, createPlugin, registryPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";
import type { Voiceover } from "@moku-labs/ai";

const handler: Voiceover.VoiceoverHandler = {
  estimate: request => ({ usd: request.text.length * 0.00003 }),
  execute: async (request, { signal }) => ({
    audio: await acmeSynthesize(request.text, request.voice, signal),
    mimeType: "audio/mpeg",
    costUsd: request.text.length * 0.00003
  })
};

export const acmeTtsPlugin = createPlugin("acmeTts", {
  depends: [registryPlugin],
  onInit: ctx => {
    ctx.require(registryPlugin).register("voiceover", "acme", handler);
  }
});

const app = createApp({
  plugins: [acmeTtsPlugin],
  pluginConfigs: { voiceover: { defaultProvider: "acme", defaultFormat: "mp3" } }
});
```

Rules: implement the task's contract type; register in onInit under the task key;
throw errors carrying ProviderErrorHint fields (status/kind/retryAfterMs) so the
runner's retry taxonomy classifies them; never echo request text in messages/meta/logs.

10.2 Custom TASK (open task set — a stated product requirement). Define a contract,
register handlers under a new task key, and build files can use it immediately (the
runner validates the handler shape at dispatch, not the task name at compile):

```ts
import { createPlugin, registryPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

type StickerRequest = { prompt: string; size?: string };
type StickerHandler = {
  estimate(request: StickerRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: StickerRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }):
    Promise<{ body: Uint8Array; mimeType: string; costUsd: number }>;
    // The runner calls it with the flat request ({ ...input, params }) and stores
    // body | audio | image | video | text bytes in the CAS with the mime type.
};

const stickerHandler: StickerHandler = {
  estimate: () => ({ usd: 0.04 }),
  execute: async request => ({ body: await renderPng(request), mimeType: "image/png", costUsd: 0.04 })
};

export const stickerProviderPlugin = createPlugin("stickerProvider", {
  depends: [registryPlugin],
  onInit: ctx => ctx.require(registryPlugin).register("sticker", "acme", stickerHandler)
});
```

```yaml
items:
  - task: sticker
    input: { prompt: "a neon city skyline", size: "1024x1024" }
```

The built-in `image` (codex) and `video` (fal) tasks follow the same pattern; a video
handler exposes `submit` + `poll` so the provider job id is journaled.

10.3 Event-consumer plugin (bus subscription — the only way; no app.on):

```ts
import { createPlugin, runnerPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

export const metricsPlugin = createPlugin("metrics", {
  depends: [runnerPlugin],
  hooks: ctx => ({
    "run:done": ({ runId, totals }) => ctx.log.info("run finished", { runId, spend: totals.spendUsd }),
    "run:failed": ({ runId, error }) => ctx.log.error("run failed", { runId, error })
  })
});
```

10.4 Plugin with its own API, state, and config (full shape):

```ts
import { createPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

type Config = { greeting: string };
type State = { count: number };

export const counterPlugin = createPlugin("counter", {
  config: { greeting: "hello" } satisfies Config,
  createState: (): State => ({ count: 0 }),
  api: ctx => ({
    bump: () => {
      ctx.state.count += 1;
      ctx.log.info(ctx.config.greeting, { count: ctx.state.count });
      return ctx.state.count;
    }
  })
});
// app.counter.bump() after createApp({ plugins: [counterPlugin] }).start()
```

Every custom plugin's ctx automatically carries ctx.journal, ctx.store, ctx.limits,
ctx.log, ctx.env (core APIs) plus emit/require per its declarations. Family rules for
plugin source: render CLI output through @moku-labs/common/cli (MC1), log via ctx.log
(MC2), read env via ctx.env (MC3).

10.5 Testing conventions: mock the structural APIs (JournalApi/StoreApi/LimitsApi are
plain object types — fake object literals satisfy them); assemble a private framework
with createCore(coreConfig, { plugins: [...], pluginConfigs: { journal: { path: tmp },
store: { dir: tmp } } }) to pin core-plugin paths into a temp dir. Plugin tests live in
src/plugins/<name>/__tests__/{unit,integration}; root tests/ is framework-level only.
522 tests, 90% coverage threshold. Run: bun run test.
